legend.title: Champion Legend
legend.description: Optional Champion Legend. A Legend covers two of your three domain slots.

champion.title: Chosen Champion
champion.description: Optional Chosen Champion within your three domains. Does not need to match your Legend champion tag.

mainDeck.title: Main Deck
mainDeck.description: At least 25 Main Deck cards. You may play more if your pool allows.

runes.title: Rune Deck
runes.description: Exactly 12 Rune cards from up to three domains.

battlefields.title: Battlefields
battlefields.description: Up to 3 Battlefield cards (optional). Duplicate names are allowed.

sideboard.title: Sideboard
sideboard.description: Up to 8 Main Deck cards. Signature cards cannot be sideboarded.

constraints.message: Sealed decks may use up to three domains. A Legend or Signature covers two of those domains.
Chosen Champion must be a Champion Unit (supertype: Champion).
Signature cards cannot be added to the sideboard.
No per-card copy limit — play as many copies as you opened.
